title: Offshore asset occupancy codes
text:
Offshore asset occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following offshore
 asset occupancy class codes.
Since Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) codes are not mapped to 900-series codes, "n/a"
 indicates that the column is not applicable.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 900 | Unknown | n/a | Offshore platform occupancy is unknown. |
| 901 | Oil Production Only | n/a | Offshore platforms that only produce oil. |
| 902 | Gas Production Only | n/a | Offshore platforms that only produce gas. |
| 903 | No Production | n/a | Offshore platforms that do not produce oil or gas. |
| 904 | Oil and Gas Production | n/a | Offshore platforms that produce oil and gas. |
| 905 | Drilling | n/a | Platforms used for drilling. |
| 906 | Workover | n/a | Platforms that repair or stimulate existing production wells for the
 purpose of restoring, prolonging, or enhancing the production of
 hydrocarbons. |
| 907 | Ready Stacked | n/a | Rigs that are not under contract but generally are ready for service. |
| 908 | Waiting on Location | n/a | Waiting on location. |
| 909 | Pipelines | n/a | Pipelines. This occupancy class is for accumulation only. |
